The Pactrade Marine product (id: 856196) is the best match for the user's requirements:

2. It has a black plastic-tipped end and interior that protects your rod - addresses the "without causing any damage" requirement
3. It's a standard rod holder that accommodates standard rod sizes

The surepromise product (id: 814667) also fits 19-25mm rails (which includes 7/8" to 1") and has a full length internal plastic sleeve which keeps your rod free of the stainless tubing.

Both are good options, but the Pactrade Marine one specifically mentions 7/8" to 1" which is exactly what the user asked for. Let me go with that one as the primary recommendation.
